blocks.title: Send Your Sourcing Inquiry.
blocks.subtitle: Connect with our sourcing team. We respond to all qualified inquiries within 48 hours.

blocks.title: Request for Quotation
blocks.subtitle: All fields marked * are required. We respond with pricing within 48 hours.

commitment.label: OUR COMMITMENT
commitment.text: Every inquiry receives a personal response within 48 hours — including preliminary pricing and available certifications.

steps.title: We Review Your Inquiry
steps.description: Our sourcing team reviews your product requirements, volume, and destination. We match your specifications against current harvest availability.

steps.title: You Receive a Proposal
steps.description: We send a detailed quotation including unit pricing, available certifications, lead time, and a sample documentation package.

steps.title: Sample & Confirmation
steps.description: Upon agreement, we dispatch a product sample with full Certificate of Analysis. Purchase order and export documentation follow.

blocks.preheading: NOT READY TO SEND AN RFQ?
blocks.title: Request our Product & Certification Catalogue.
blocks.subtitle: Receive full product specifications, pricing tiers, and all active certificates as a single PDF package. No commitment required.
